description: This file defines a custom watch face service using OpenGL rendering for an Android Wear OS device. It extends Gles2WatchFaceService and implements OpenGL rendering to display an animated and textured watch face with tick marks and hands, handling ambient and interactive modes.

classes.name: OpenGLWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main class extending Gles2WatchFaceService, responsible for creating the watch face engine.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending Gles2WatchFaceService.Engine, managing rendering, camera setup, and mode transitions.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns the Engine instance for the watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face style and logs creation.

methods.name: onGlContextCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL program, prepares geometry (tick marks, hands), and precomputes camera and clock matrices.

methods.name: onGlSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Sets up the projection matrix based on surface dimensions and precomputes combined matrices for rendering.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Handles mode change, logging, and handles rendering adjustments.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Registers or unregisters receivers based on visibility, updates time zone.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Updates the display periodically (per minute) in interactive mode.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Performs the OpenGL drawing routine, rendering tick marks and clock hands according to current time and mode.

search-terms: Android Wear OS OpenGL watch face
